life.release: Release one (it dies and is buried)

mats.name: Bacterial mats
mats.desc: Breathe out oxygen. Leave lime crusts.

plankton.name: Plankton
plankton.desc: Shell ooze and marine organics. The root of oil.

molluscs.name: Molluscs
molluscs.desc: Shells become chalk. Fossil: the spiral shell.

mosses.name: Mosses & ferns
mosses.desc: Land organics — the root of peat and coal.

trees.name: Trees
trees.desc: Organics and resin. Resin becomes amber.

predators.name: Predator packs
predators.desc: Double the death rate of prey in their zone.

litoralis.name: Homo litoralis — Shorefolk
litoralis.desc: Live by the water. Energy from the sea +20%.

lapis.name: Homo lapis — Stonebearers
lapis.desc: The temple rises faster; they press the ground harder.

tribe.name: Tribe
tribe.desc: Settles by the artifact. Digs toward it in the last era.

elements.target: Choose layers in the section (Esc to cancel)

flood.name: Flood
flood.desc: Buries the lowlands at once (burial ×5). Drowns the weak.

drought.name: Drought
drought.desc: Sand and dunes on land. Part of the land life dies.

groundwater.name: Groundwater
groundwater.desc: Chosen layers get water: fossils ×3, sandstone.

heat.name: Deep heat
heat.desc: +60 °C in chosen layers: oil window, marble, quartzite.

volcano.name: Volcano
volcano.desc: Ash buries everything (×5), mass death, warms the depths.

seaAdvance.name: Sea advances
seaAdvance.desc: Water takes the coast; sea deposits ×2 there.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.desc: Folds the layers, lifts deep rock, uncovers finds.

glacier.name: Glacier
glacier.desc: Moraines and a crushing weight from above for 1,000 years.

meteor.name: Meteorite
meteor.desc: Crater, iridium layer, rare minerals. Half of life dies.

magma.name: Magma intrusion
magma.desc: A pocket of magma warms its neighbours, cools into granite.

rockHow.stromatolite: bacterial mats leave lime crusts; bury them under ~20 rows
rockHow.chalk: plankton and molluscs leave shell ooze; bury it
rockHow.peat: land plants buried below the oxygen zone
rockHow.oil: marine organics at 60–120 °C — use Deep heat
rockHow.diamond: coal at extreme pressure and 250 °C, rarely
rockHow.obsidian: lava cooling fast at the surface
rockHow.gneiss: granite or shale, hot and pressed

tip.click: click: write it in the chronicle

epoch.explain: Compacted layers become foundation. History above the artifact begins again — faster and deeper.
epoch.foundation: Foundation {v} m (+{p} MPa to every layer)
epoch.confirm: Close this epoch? Energy, life, rocks and upgrades reset. You get +{v} Density.

deepMemory.name: Deep memory
deepMemory.desc: Start from a later era you have reached (2 → 5)

legacy.name: Legacy
legacy.desc: Keep 10% of each species after a shift

book.chronicleEmpty: Click a layer in the section to write its entry.
book.notesEmpty: Notes surface from the depths during epoch shifts and earthquakes.
book.museumHint: Each fossil: +2% transformation speed. Rare: +2% fossil chance, +1% Energy. A full era set: +10% Energy.

memory.m_train: The last train leaves at noon. We will leave it here.
memory.m_laugh: They laughed: why bury something that will never break.
memory.m_answer: We found the answer. It was simpler than all our books.
memory.m_someone: Someone will come. Let them find at least something.
memory.m_square: There was a square here. I was here.
memory.m_light: Leave the light on, she said. Someone might need it.
memory.m_list: Things you cannot take: weight, names, the habit of waiting.
memory.m_voices: Voices again. Not ours. Close, though.
memory.m_fire: Fire. Somebody is keeping a fire above me.
memory.m_heavy: Everything that was is getting heavier. That is how it stays.
memory.m_stone: Coal remembers being a forest. Diamond does not.

n01.title: Announcement of the Transition
n01.text: To all residents. The Transition begins at dawn on the 1st. Bring nothing. Platforms open at 06:00. There is nothing to fear. There never was.

n02.title: A letter to a daughter
n02.text: Mila — I put the old thing in the ground by the square, where you used to draw chalk circles. I know it is silly. Someone ought to stay, even if it is only an object.

n03.title: A journal page
n03.text: …the result has now been reproduced in every laboratory. The question that occupied philosophy for six thousand years has an answer, and the answer is not a sentence. It is a direction.

n04.title: Conservation instructions
n04.text: Do not clean. Do not polish. Do not open. Store below frost depth. The object requires no power. It will outlast the container, the site and the curator.

n05.title: A child's drawing
n05.text: A circle with rays. Under it, in big letters: THIS IS YOU. A smaller circle beside it: THIS IS ME LEAVING.

n06.title: What you cannot take
n06.text: Weight. Names. Pets (they come differently). Grudges. The habit of waiting. Keys — there will be no doors.

n07.title: Last radio broadcast
n07.text: …this is the city service, final transmission. The square is empty. The trains are gone. If anyone is listening, it is a beautiful morning. We are switching off now.

n08.title: Diary of one who stayed
n08.text: Day 40. The grass is already over the rails. I talk to the thing in the ground. It is warm. I swear it is warm.

n09.title: A ticket stub
n09.text: Platform 3. Seat: any. Destination field left blank, as instructed.

n10.title: A museum label
n10.text: Object of unknown purpose, c. 3011. Indestructible. Emits a faint warmth. Donated anonymously, with a note: 'for whoever is next'.

n11.title: Graffiti
n11.text: WE WERE HERE. WE WERE SO MUCH HERE.

n12.title: The last page
n12.text: I am the last. Tomorrow I go too. I leave you the light. Do something good with the time — there will be so much of it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: Erase all progress, including the museum and notes? This cannot be undone.

finale.choose: What will they do with it?
finale.once: Each ritual can be chosen once.
finale.newWorld: History continues in a changed world.
finale.end: The history is written. Other paths will open later.

bury.name: Bury it deeper
bury.act: They lower it back into the earth, deeper — to return it.
bury.world: A hot world: steeper heat, volcanoes wake on their own, magma, basalt, granite, gems. Organics burn above 150 °C.

eat.name: Eat it
eat.act: They grind it to powder and eat it.
eat.world: A living world: mutations each era, rock ranks I–V, glowing life and glowstone.

shatter.name: Break it and share
shatter.act: They split it and carry the pieces to different tribes.
shatter.world: A world of shards: three shards, three basins, a bonus for diversity. Three digs to finish.
